prompts.effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game VFX SPRITE ATLAS, 4 columns by 4 rows, square 2048x2048, transparent RGBA. Exactly sixteen equally spaced independent effects centered in each cell, transparent 12% padding inside each cell. No characters, no weapons with handles, no backgrounds, no typography, NO checkerboard. Elaborate high-end 2D anime action RPG luminous brush-painted spell effects: silver-white cores, deep crimson, rose-magenta, violet sparks, strong bloom but crisp layered ribbons, shards, magical runes. Shapes drawn in flat XY plane; not isometric ground; renderer projects them. Row1: 1 rightward pointed crescent slash (tip points right); 2 rightward fast triple wind blade; 3 circular spinning slash vortex; 4 rightward wide iaijutsu fan blade. Row2: 1 circular landing impact explosion; 2 curved magical parry shield; 3 ghostly violet afterimage blade; 4 three parallel rightward crimson slash trails. Row3: 1 rightward arrowhead homing comet; 2 returning crescent boomerang; 3 intricate circular blade field sigil; 4 jagged armor-shattering fracture burst. Row4: 1 inward pulling crimson chains vortex; 2 elegant silvery moon stance ring; 3 detailed crescent target sigil; 4 vertical blood-red blade aura. Each effect isolated well within its own exact quarter cell, all16 fully visible and stylistically unified. These are vivid game combat FX textures, not app icons or framed cards. Keep each silhouette strongly distinct, high material richness and dramatic intensity. Transparent background required.
